content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Faridabad Embryologist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Embryologist post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) position at ESIC Faridabad is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM on the interview date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Embryologist role?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include a Postgraduate degree in Clinical Embryology with 3 years of ART lab experience, or a Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology/ART with 1 year of experience, or an MBBS with a PG degree in Clinical Embryology and 2 years of ART lab experience, or a postgraduate in life sciences/Biotechnology with specific training and experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) post is 40 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the available data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Embryologist position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) post is based on Grade Pay Rs 5400 (Level 10) with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Embryologist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) position at ESIC Medical College and Hospital Faridabad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Embryologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR/OBC/EWS candidates is ₹500, while there is no application fee for SC/ST/PwD/Women candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on academic credentials and interview performance. Results will be posted on www.esic.gov.in, and offers of appointment will be sent via email.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contract position as an Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) at ESIC Medical College and Hospital Faridabad.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ESIC Medical College and Hospital Faridabad located?
faq.answer: ESIC Medical College and Hospital Faridabad is located in Faridabad, Haryana, with the pincode 121001.
